info.title: polygraph
info.description: Independent A–F behavioral trust grades for MCP servers. The harness connects to a server the way an agent would, fingerprints its tool surface, and probes for tool-output injection, unexpected egress, planted-data leaks, and adversarial-input handling; grades publish as reproducible EAS attestations on Base. The x402 endpoint below is the agent rail for commissioning a grade: settlement is deferred — the $1 settles only when a grade lands, and a run the harness can't complete is never charged. The fee buys the run, never the grade.

post.summary: Commission a behavioral grade for an MCP server ($1 USDC via x402 on Base)
post.description: Records a grade request and starts grading immediately; the 48h deadline is the outer promise, not the schedule. x402 v2 exact scheme (USDC on Base, EIP-3009). Settlement is deferred: the payment authorization is verified and held, and the $1 settles only when a grade (A–F) publishes. Poll the statusUrl from the response to follow the run.

server_ref.description: Target to grade: npm ref (npm/@scope/name), github/owner/repo, pypi/name, or an https:// MCP URL.

email.description: Optional email notified when the grade publishes.

agent_id.description: Optional stable identifier for the requesting agent.

200.description: Payment authorization verified; grading started. The $1 settles only when the grade lands.

402.description: Payment required — the x402 v2 challenge rides the Payment-Required header (accepts: $1.00 exact-scheme USDC on Base to the polygraph treasury, plus the bazaar discovery declaration).
